modules.title: studio/bench/run_bench.py: capability probes written to studio/capabilities.json
Guards before a stage: capability, VRAM, disk, temperature, lock, hold

absent.behaviour: no capability report or no entry for a probe: the stage is refused with reason `capability` and exit 5, or the web shows the tool "Not yet run"; nothing crashes

fixture.behaviour: a fixture report allows the fake backend only and is never shown as a measured probe

partial.behaviour: an entry for each probe that ran; a stage that lists a missing probe is refused, the others run

real.behaviour: the contract-valid artefact is used as specified by DC-000-02; no label, no caveat

stale.behaviour: a report whose driver differs from the live driver is refused `capability-stale`

invalid.behaviour: an invalid report is rejected and treated as absent
